_comment: Config for enricher.py. Any key starting with '_' is a comment and is ignored. Replace every REPLACE_ placeholder before running.
_comment_apify_keys: One entry per Apify account. token = Apify API token (Console > Settings > API & Integrations). label = unique name used in logs/progress.json. linkedin_cookie = your LinkedIn li_at cookie ('li_at=AQED...' or just the value), or null if this account should not run the phone scraper.
_comment_rotation_strategy: 'round-robin' (key1 > key2 > key3 > key1 ...) or 'sequential' (use one key until it is exhausted, then the next).
_comment_max_usage_per_key_usd: Skip a key once its monthly Apify usage reaches this amount (free tier = $5/month). The account's own limit is used if lower.
_comment_usage_safety_margin_usd: Treat a key as over budget when usage >= max_usage_per_key_usd - this margin, so a final run can't push it over.
_comment_batch_size: Save the enriched Excel file and progress.json every N contacts.
_comment_delay_between_calls_seconds: Pause after each actor run. Override on the command line with --delay.
_comment_actor_timeout_seconds: Give up on an actor run (and abort it) after this many seconds of polling.
_comment_poll_interval_seconds: How often to poll a running actor for its status.
_comment_accept_guessed_emails: The LinkedIn actor may return pattern-guessed emails (email_source = 'guessed'). Set to false to keep only discovered emails.
_comment_actors: Optional: override actor IDs if you switch to a different actor on the Apify Store.
_comment_phone_actor_input: Input sent to the phone actor. {profile_url} and {li_at} are filled in at runtime. Check the actor's Input tab on Apify and adjust the field names if they differ.
